answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, produced by trusted hardware. Verifiers accept votes only when remote attestation proves the registered code and platform state, so copied keys or duplicate virtual machines cannot create equivalent identities. A Sybil operator must acquire additional physical silicon and pass fresh attestation; sparrow, falcon, and sable are labels, not virtual replicas.
